title.narrative: Support in implementation of the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and further development of Performance-Based Maintenance (PBMC)

description.narrative: The Technical Assistance should support Public Enterprise Road of Serbia and other relevant line ministries to implement efficient management of public assets, better use of funds allocated for road maintenance through Service Level Agreement (SLA), Performance Maintenance Based Contracts (PBMCs) and support development of Road Asset Management System (RAMS). A basic indicator for measuring the objective achievement is savings in funds spent for maintenance of km of road network with the same or better quality service level defined from the prospective of the road users who will benefit through lower Road User Costs (RUC).
